card.text: A Cepheid in the Milky Way, 92 times the Sun's width, that swells and shrinks every 23.0 days.

sources.label: Groenewegen (2012)
sources.locator: table10, BM Per: Per, Rad, Dist

introduction.text: Its mean radius, 91.9 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 2,253 parsecs away.
